headline: The story behind No Tall Order
subheading: Fifteen years of client work across a dozen industries shaped how I think about marketing.

milestones.title: Agency work
milestones.description: I started at J3 Effect right out of college. Three years in an agency, running real campaigns and learning how marketing works inside a business.

milestones.title: Teaching
milestones.description: At the same time, I taught social media marketing to Tucson businesses at The SMART Group, back when most of them were still deciding whether Facebook was worth their time. Teaching forced me to get precise about what works.

milestones.title: Working for free
milestones.description: I launched No Tall Order by offering free work. I ran social media for Ben's Bells, helped a local co-working space build a referral strategy, and organized Nerd Row, a weekly programmer meetup that brought the space several new members. That same year I judged business plans for the Women's Business Center in Tucson.

milestones.title: First major client
milestones.description: My first real project was redesigning a financial company's website. I managed the whole thing, brought in developers, and kept it moving. I learned that good marketing means coordinating people and logistics as much as generating ideas.

milestones.title: Adding video
milestones.description: I picked up a drone and started doing videography, partnering with Paul Holze and Groundwork Promotions. I founded Falcon Flight Photography and added video to what I could offer clients.

milestones.title: Shift to digital
milestones.description: In-person shoots stopped. I moved to digital. I was already helping OOROO Auto with their marketing and shifted to LinkedIn campaigns to generate leads for their business. (I also met my wife at OOROO.)

milestones.title: Campaigns
milestones.description: I teamed up with Danny Kirk at Kirk & Co, where we ran over 500 B2B marketing campaigns across cold email, podcasts, Reddit, and more. I learned what works across industries, and what doesn't. That chapter wraps up in August 2026.

milestones.title: Digital Marketing Consultant
milestones.description: I'm shifting from project work to embedded roles. Four to six established companies, working as their digital marketing consultant: building the strategy, running campaigns, and tracking results.

items.title: Channel-agnostic
items.description: I've run real campaigns across cold email, social, video, podcasts, Reddit, and referral systems. I recommend what fits your buyer.

items.title: Hands-on
items.description: I've managed builds, hired teams, founded companies, and pivoted through a pandemic. I know how the work gets done.

items.title: One focus
items.description: Fifteen years, one constant: helping businesses reach new customers.

cta.headline: Want to be one of those four to six?
cta.subheading: Book a free call. If it's a fit, we'll figure out what the engagement looks like.
